EXPLANATION: Spectrum shows only aliphatic C–H stretches (2875, 2931 cm⁻¹) with no C=C or C=O bands, so the analyte is a saturated O-containing molecule. Fingerprint region has several C–O and C–O–C stretching bands (1041, 1058, 1163, 1176 cm⁻¹) plus strong ring-breathing/deformation peaks at 851, 800 and 523 cm⁻¹, consistent with a cyclic acetal (1,3-dioxane type) that contains two ring oxygens and an exocyclic OH group. Among the candidates, only 1 (OC1COCCCOC1) possesses a 1,3-dioxane ring with an additional hydroxyl oxygen, providing the required combination of two ether C-O-C linkages and an alcohol C–O stretch, matching the multiplicity and positions of the observed C–O bands better than the mono-oxygen cycloalkanols/ethers in other candidates. Therefore, candidate 1 is the most compatible choice.
